claim: A picture you chose with a Play button on it stands in for the video; YouTube is not contacted and the video is not loaded until play is pressed
Paste a watch, short or embed link; upload your own poster (no automatic YouTube thumbnail); title used for the Play button
Plays in place in privacy-enhanced mode, which reduces but does not remove YouTube's tracking, with related videos from the same channel
If the site runs Privacy Centre, refusal of marketing cookies, or a Global Privacy Control signal, shows a message and loads nothing
Without scripts, a link to watch on YouTube
